no_adcom_quote.quote: There was no Advisory Committee convened to discuss this application because the clinical trial design was acceptable and the application did not raise questions that necessitated seeking input from outside expertise.

summary: No FDA advisory committee was convened for the LINZESS (linaclotide) NDA 202811. The Summary Review, Cross-Discipline Team Leader review, and Medical Review all explicitly state that no AC meeting was held because the clinical trial design was acceptable and the application raised no significant safety or efficacy issues requiring outside expert input. With no committee, there are no AC-concern-to-approval-change linkages; the pediatric boxed warning/contraindication arose from the FDA review team's own assessment, not from an advisory committee.
